deals.name: Thiel Capital’s Jack Selby nabs stakes in hot startups like Etched through Arizona connections
deals.summary: Selby's VC firm, Copper Sky Capital, is currently raising a $300 million second fund, according to a regulatory filing.

deals.name: Whoop’s valuation just tripled to $10 billion
deals.summary: The fitness tracking startup just closed a $575 million Series G with Cristiano Ronaldo and LeBron James among its investors. The obvious question looming over a round of this size at this valuation: Is an IPO coming?

deals.name: Modelence raises $3M to smooth out the vibe-coding stack
deals.summary: How do you build tooling for the AI software stack? A company called Modelence has an interesting answer.

deals.name: VC firm 2150 raises €210M fund to solve cities’ climate challenges
deals.summary: Europe-based venture fund 2150 raised the money to invest in climate tech startups that help solve cities' carbon footprint.

deals.name: Superorganism raises $25M to back biodiversity startups
deals.summary: Superorganism backs companies across three categories: tech that slows or reverses extinction, startups that operate at the intersection of climate and biodiversity, and tools that enable conservationists to do their work more effectively.

deals.name: More than 100 new tech unicorns were minted in 2025 — here they are
deals.summary: Using data from Crunchbase and PitchBook, TechCrunch tracked down the VC-backed startups that became unicorns so far this year.

deals.name: Sequoia unveils $950M in new early-stage funds as it strives to be ‘only as good as our next investment’
deals.summary: The legendary firm launched a $750 million early-stage fund targeting Series A startups and a $200 million seed fund.

deals.name: Redwood Materials raises another $350M to power up its energy-storage business
deals.summary: The round was led by Eclipse and saw participation from Nvidia's venture capital arm, NVentures.

deals.name: A new search engine raises $1.1M to let obsessive fans dive down internet rabbit holes
deals.summary: Lore raises $1.1 million to build a personalized search engine for fandom culture.

deals.name: A year after filing to IPO, still-private Cerebras Systems raises $1.1B
deals.summary: Cerebras initially filed to go public in September 2024 but ran into several regulatory delays due to foreign investments.

deals.name: Doorstep raises $8M seed to help find missing food deliveries
deals.summary: Doorstep integrates into existing delivery apps and then, using phone sensors, tracks when a driver has entered a building, gone up an elevator, and made it to the desired doorstep.

deals.name: Why Paradigm built a spreadsheet with an AI agent in every cell
deals.summary: Paradigm raised a $5 million seed round and is releasing it's AI-powered spreadsheet to the general public.

deals.name: NeoLogic wants to build more energy-efficient CPUs for AI data centers
deals.summary: To fund its vision of building more energy-efficient server CPUs, NeoLogic recently raised a $10 million Series A round led by KOMPAS VC with participation from M Ventures, Maniv Mobility, and lool Ventures.

deals.name: Amazon backs programmable optics startup Lumotive
deals.summary: Lumotive reopened its February Series B round to add Amazon's Industrial Innovation Fund and ITHCA Group, increasing the size of the round to $59 million.

deals.name: Three things veteran planetary health investors look for in a startup
deals.summary: RA Capital Planetary Health closed a $120 million fund. Here's the rubric two investors use to determine where to place their fund's money.

deals.name: AI voice company Hyper raises $6.3M to help automate 911 calls
deals.summary: Hyper hopes to use the fresh capital to help scale across the country, integrate more into existing 911 systems, hire a head of engineering, and build its next product.

deals.name: Catalio Capital closes over $400M Fund IV
deals.summary: Catalio Capital Management announced the closing of its more than $400 million Fund IV. The fund will continue the firm’s thesis of backing healthcare and biotechnology companies.
